name: Necromancy Rituals — 3 Advanced — Ritual of Teyolia

system.description: Known only to Pochtli and his most trusted lieutenants among the Pisanob, this rite tears the still-beating heart from a Kindred sacrifice bound atop the Temple of Pochtli, visiting Final Death upon the victim, and preserves the heart's blood (teyolia) in a vessel called a chac mool. No roll is required; the process succeeds automatically unless interrupted. The preserved heart can later be consumed to diablerize the sacrificed vampire, or reportedly used to fuel other potent necromantic castings. Discovery of this practice by Giovanni outside the Pisanob could see the entire branch extinguished by the wider clan.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
